rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a warm, approachable quality or impression.

example.english: Their smile gives people a sense of friendliness.
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 siu3 zau6 hou2 jau5 can1 cit3 gam2

rows.note: Use this when the friendliness emphasizes human warmth and a personal touch rather than simple politeness.

example.english: This little shop has a real sense of friendliness.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 siu2 dim3 hou2 jau5 jan4 cing4 mei6

rows.note: Use this when describing someone's approachable quality or ability to put others at ease, especially in work or public-facing contexts.

example.english: Friendliness is essential in customer service.
example.traditional: 做客服最緊要有親和力。
example.jyutping: zou6 haak3 fuk6 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 jau5 can1 wo4 lik6
